rows.description: A young child trusts a friendly stranger or a sweet-looking food because it feels good and fears a plain-looking helper because he feels nervous. Feelings guide judgments.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, fear, anxiety, trust

rows.description: A child who likes a subject thinks it is easy and useful, while one he dislikes seems hard and pointless. Emotion supplies quick answers about risk and benefit.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager judges something risky by how exciting or scary it feels, not by facts. Things he likes seem low-risk and high-benefit, and things he dislikes the opposite.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: joy, fear, excitement

rows.subtype: Gut feeling on people and products [Actor]
rows.description: A student picks a brand, a job or a person because it just feels right, then builds reasons afterward. Emotion drives and reason justifies.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A thoughtful adult notes her feeling, treats it as information, and then asks what evidence supports or contradicts it before acting on big matters.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A preschooler acts on the first impulse, grabbing, hitting or running, with little pause to think. Slow thinking is only beginning to develop.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child learns to catch a wrong first answer to a trick question with a brief pause. Quick answers feel right but can mislead.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager moves between snap gut choices, especially with friends watching, and careful reasoning when calm. Heightened emotion and peers favour the fast mode.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young adult trusts quick intuition for familiar low-stakes matters and slows down with checklists, sleep and advice for big, new or irreversible ones.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A team notices one person over-analysing simple choices and another gut-deciding complex ones. The wise help each match effort to the stakes and to the type of problem.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
